observations: Two primaries live in one file: the style-guide colour page says Primary/500 #FF321F and the component library uses pink #FF3E7B + pink→violet Gradient/main, but every 067 Theme Flow screen is re-skinned with 067/Main-500 #FF3240 and the 067/Gradient #FE513A→#FC4649. Build TM screens from the 067 tokens.
Screen ink is Black #12111C, not the style-guide swatch #272538.

Every filled pill uses radius 100 and the 'Button' effect (inset 2 2 4 #FFB5FF80 + inset 0 -4 8 #971B421A). Size ladder: XS 24, S 28, M 32, L 40, XL 48. Dialog buttons are 52 (Nunito); ad CTAs are 52 (48 in item/popup, 32 in small rows).

Font: the screens use Momo Trust Sans (+ Momo Trust Display for section titles). The typography frame's 'font/family' variable resolves to Inter, the ads are Inter, the master wireframe is Poppins, dialogs pasted from another kit are Nunito Sans, segmented tabs are Instrument Sans.
Side margins: 20 on 412 base-flow frames, 16 on 375 core screens. Content width 372 / 343.

Native ads are full-width (412) #FAFAFA blocks with full-bleed media (no radius, no inset). The header is a 44 logo + tag + headline row. The CTA is a 52-high pill inset 20. AdChoices is a 12px info glyph at the top-left corner.
In the flow the ad tag/CTA take the screen primary: #FF3240 / 067 gradient in TM, #FF3E7B in the catalogue, #FF6616 in the wireframe.
Language selection is shown only by the radio fill plus a 24 tick icon in the header; the row itself never changes (no stroke, no tint).
The OB CTA is text only (Poppins SemiBold 20/24, accent colour) on the right of the indicator row at y575. The indicator is a 4-high bar with an 18 pill and 4 dots.
Single 80x4 red r100 bar used as both the banner pager and the settings/collection section divider.
Header for tab roots is 78 (22 status + 56 bar) with a script wordmark; sub-screens use back chevron + centred Momo SemiBold 16 title + 24 action.
Dialogs/sheets: white r12 card, header p16 (title SemiBold 16 + close 24), body px16, buttons p16 gap 8, 5-layer 'pop up shadow', scrim rgba(0,0,0,.4). Sheets float 16 from the sides and bottom.
TA differs only in skin: bg #FCF4FF, accent #A875FC, Gorditas wordmark, 3D clay icons, white r12 tiles, 82-high nav with a purple top hairline, chips 32 high with Instrument Sans 16.
Several TM apply-flow frames (download, downloading, success, with-ad) and the TM splash are flattened images with no layers, so their geometry is unmeasured.

observations: One brand colour drives everything: #A875FC fills every CTA, pill, countdown box, selected border, check circle, radio, OB title, OB Next, nav label and segmented active.

Two button shapes coexist: the component 'button' (Big 328x52, Medium 280x42, Small 90x36, Popup 142x42) is radius 24; the paywall Continue and the language Next pill are radius 100. Button text is Momo Medium 18/22 except paywall Continue (SemiBold 18/22).
Dialogs are white, radius 24, 24 padding (update) or 24/16 (rating), content centred, single full-width 328x52 primary button at the bottom, title Bold 20/28.
Language selection changes ONLY the radio (grey ring #7B7B7B -> primary); the row has no border, no tint. Confirm = filled 72x32 'Next' pill (Momo Medium 14) appearing at top-right after a choice.
Onboarding: image 412x468 with a 100px fade; text block at y480; indicator + text CTA at y572; indicator active pill is ink #363636 (not primary); CTA is Poppins SemiBold 20 primary with no chevron.

The RI Language/OB template has NO native-ad slot and no hand hint; the bottom ~321px of every OB page is blank. The RI Ads page keeps the generic dark #2E2E37 Native Media_Big with orange #FF6616 CTA/Ad tag (not brand-recoloured).

Paywall rhythm (375x812): hero 199, title y248, subtitle y286, benefits y338 (scrolling), plans y385 gap 12, CTA y726, footer y788. Plan card radius 12, padding 10/8, selected border 2 primary, unselected 1px 20% primary.

Typefaces are mixed: Momo Trust Sans is the system (T24..T10 scale), but Poppins (language title, OB Next), Gorditas (wordmark), Figtree (home banner), Inter (benefits, ads), Instrument Sans (segmented), Nunito Sans (footer, 'Excellent!') and Sulphur Point (uninstall survey) leak in from copied components.

observations: PS 'arcade button' system: every raised element = r6 + 2px white rim + HARD drop 0 3 0 (no blur) in a tinted colour + inner top gloss inset 0 2 2 #FFFFFF40. Applies to CTAs, segments, cards, back button, language rows (purple tint), toggle card (solid #FF661A).
PS radius scale is 6 / 8 / 12 / 20 (buttons+tiles+nav pill 6; swatch+language row 8; content cards 12; dialog 20). Nothing is a full pill.

PS type stack: Press Start 2P (wordmark/titles 20) + Pixelify Sans (section/card titles 16–20) + Inter (UI labels) + Figtree (captions, splash) + Momo Trust (base flow, nav label). Base flow uses Momo Trust like the other team files; core screens switch to pixel faces.

Both apps' nav: active tab = gradient pill with icon+label that MOVES to the tapped slot; inactive tabs icon-only. PS: white bar 68, pill 132x44 r6, label before icon. RT: #121921 bar 72 with top radius 24, pill h44 r44, icon before label, filled vs outline icons.

RT dark ladder: #000 bg → #1A1A1F surfaces (cards, chips, dialogs, search, language rows) → #2E2E37 (unselected bars, ad block). One gradient #FF539B→#E1336D carries every accent incl. gradient TEXT (OB title, Next, outline-button label).
RT keeps paywall and rating dialog LIGHT (white / white-80% blur) inside a black app; their copy colours come from the light set (#282A39, #787878, #43434E).
RT button heights: 48 (r40, dialog + bottom action), 52 (r100, paywall/rating CTA), 32 (r12, inline Allow). Bottom action sits at x16 y738 h48 (24 above frame bottom).

Ads: SDK symbols are drawn in SDK orange #FF6616 on #FAFAFA, but the instances placed in the RT flow are re-skinned to the app (bg #2E2E37, pink gradient Ad tag + CTA, white headline). Ad CTA is a full-width 372 pill 48–52 high, not 40; AdChoices 'i' 12px sits at the TOP-LEFT corner.
RT language/OB use Native Media_Item 412x296 pinned at y621 (not Media_Big 300). PS language/OB frames have no ad drawn (OB bottom 314 left blank).

Language selection marks only the control (PS gradient checkbox / RT radio); the row itself does not change fill or border. Confirm = plain 24 tick icon at x364 y75 (PS green, RT pink) — not a filled circle.
OB Next is text-only (no chevron): PS Figtree Bold 18 #FF8548; RT Poppins SemiBold 20 gradient. Indicator 42x4 = pill 18 + three 4px dots, gap 4.
Dialog widths: PS 312 (r20, pad 12/32); RT 343 (r24, pad 16) on a 90% near-black overlay; rating 362 (r24).

Drawing inconsistencies to not copy: RT splash 158:17594 is a ThemeArt leftover (wrong icon/name); RT LFO2 shows the confirm tick with no row selected; PS splash file style 'Colors/Primary' reads #FF0984 (stale).

observations: CV primary CTA is always a pill (radius 100/40) in #FF6078; height 52 for screen CTAs (paywall Continue, ad CTA), 48 for in-screen actions (Unlock), 40 for sheet actions (Done), 32 for the language Next, 28 for banner pills.
CV mixes 3 families by role: Roboto for app chrome (bars, sections, settings, result), Momo Trust Sans for base flow + CTA labels, Inter/Poppins inside ad units; Nunito Sans only in paywall plans.
CV badges on content: 28 dark-translucent circles at 12px inset (heart left, VIP diamond right), type glyph 24 bottom-right at 8 inset.

Native units in the SDK library use Primary/500 #FF6616; every instance in an app's screens is recoloured to that app's primary (CV #FF6078, SC #E00000). Ad bg is near-white (#FAFAFA CV, #F6F6F7 SC) even on saturated screens.
Native CTA inside ads is 52 tall (py16) for 412-wide units, 48 for Small/Item; ad headline is only 12/14 and body 10/12 — much smaller than the kit's 14/18 and 12/16.
AdChoices 'i' sits at the top-LEFT corner (0,0, 12px) of every native unit in the Light SDK set.

Native full: 8 immersive variants (scrims + white text, close X 36 #0B0A0A80 / countdown pill / progress bar 'Ad 1 to 2') and 5 contained variants (blurred creative + 240 square media + 80 advertiser icon + white text card with 'Continue'). X/countdown and the advertiser icon mirror left/right.

SC: every interactive element is a candy-stripe pill or circle with a 3px light border of the same hue and a white-top / dark-bottom inner shadow; red = primary/destructive, green = confirm/secondary (Allow, Call, settings, back, Call again).

SC call UI: accept/decline are 80 circles 64 from each edge at bottom 48; in-call quick actions are 56 circles in an 80-high translucent pill; heads-up popup is a 343x80 white card with a 5px red border and 36 call circles.
SC language has no native ad and uses pill rows; SC OB uses the collapsible Colab_Left (media first) instead of Media_Big; SC splash carries a transparent 412x52 banner at the bottom.
Both files: base flow 412x917, core screens 375x812; side margin 20 in base flow, 16 in core screens.
